name: Spring RestTemplate/WebClient SSRF via interpolated URL
attack_scenario: Attacker sets host to 169.254.169.254 (AWS/GCP metadata) or an internal admin service; the server-side client fetches it and returns credentials or internal data.
negative_test_hint: set host to "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data" and assert the server rejects the request instead of returning metadata credentials

exemplar.explanation: Passing a user-influenced string to RestTemplate (getForObject/exchange) or WebClient .uri lets an attacker point the server at internal services or the cloud metadata endpoint. Validating the host against an allowlist and blocking internal/link-local ranges before fetching keeps the server from becoming a confused deputy.
